_comment: Ratchet, not permission. Every number here is what the repo measured after the editor/ split, so any regression fails the gate. Raising one is a deliberate, reviewable act; lower it whenever the measurement drops.
_oversizeFilesComment: 7 -> 3 after the file-split pass. rich-tooltip, properties-panel, subsystems-dialog and options-bar all dropped under the line; layers-panel, menu-bar and view.tsx were what was left. 3 -> 2 when view.tsx was split into editor/canvas/* (5494 -> 865 lines); layers-panel and menu-bar are the remaining two.
_useEditorImportsComment: 8 -> 16 when subsystems-dialog.tsx was split into one file per tab. This budget counts FILES, and the nine workspaces that used to share a file now have their own. The number of useEditor() call sites is unchanged at 9 (verified before and after), so nothing subscribes to whole-editor state that did not already. Lower this only by converting a workspace to useEditorSelector, not by re-merging files.
_topLargestFilesComment: 22184 -> 22330 for the tool-behaviour pass: retouch/type option panels that did not exist, gradient blend+opacity, pen curve handles, selection-aware move. The two largest new panels were split into options-bar-tools.tsx (-363) before raising this. 22330 -> 22350 for the selection-clip / options-bar remount pass: the clip helpers went to editor/canvas/selection-helpers.ts and view.tsx's duplicate of selectionToMaskCanvas was deleted (view.tsx ends up smaller than it started); the remainder is options-bar.tsx hoisting its stateful option groups to module scope. 22350 -> 20095 for the file-split pass: preview painters left rich-tooltip for editor/tool/, ToolSection left properties-panel, the nine subsystem workspaces left subsystems-dialog, four option groups left options-bar, and layers-panel shed its leaf components plus the health/filter logic to editor/document/. 16000 -> 15113 when the last seven menus left menu-bar.tsx for components/photoshop/menus/.
_coordinationFilesComment: view.tsx maxImports went 49 -> 50 when it was split: five subsystems (overlay previews, vector editing, filter overlays, text editing, transform drag) moved to editor/canvas/*, trading one extra import for ~1100 fewer lines. 50 -> 30 when the rest left: compositing, the paint session, pointer routing, selection/document ops and the vector + transform controllers are all their own modules now, so view.tsx imports controllers rather than the primitives they call.

components/photoshop/editor/context.tsx._maxFanInComment: 96 -> 97: options-bar-tools.tsx subscribes directly rather than taking props, so only the retouch/type panels re-render on state changes instead of the whole options bar. 97 -> 107 for the file-split pass, which is arithmetic rather than coupling: the nine subsystem workspaces, properties-tool-section and layers-panel-thumbs already talked to the context, they just did it from inside a bigger file. No new consumer was introduced.

components/photoshop/menu-bar.tsx._maxImportsComment: 32 -> 35 when the last seven menus left for components/photoshop/menus/: Edit, Image, Layer and Type each got a file and Plugins/Window/Help were grouped, trading three imports for 878 fewer lines. Same trade view.tsx made above. menu-bar.tsx is now the command layer — it owns the state and the handlers and passes them down; every menu's JSX lives in menus/.
